say.never: To change inches into meters, multiply by 0.0254. To go the other way, divide by the same number. Dividing undoes multiplying, so the two conversions cancel each other out.
say.bit: Inches to meters is a multiply. The way back is a divide by the same number, so the two undo each other.

double inches = meters / 0.0254;
